EX-99.1 2 ea031111501ex99-1.htm TIZIANA LIFE SCIENCES LTD PRESS RELEASE, DATED NOVEMBER 5, 2026 Exhibit 99.1 Tiziana to Host Investor Call with Key Opinion Leaders to Discuss Positive Phase 2a INFORM-MS Topline Results ● Trial met primary endpoint with a statistically significant reduction in microglial activation on TSPO PET (p=0.0168) ● Intranasal foralumab is the first non-invasive anti-CD3 therapy that has shown a favorable safety and tolerability profile at both doses studied ● Clinically meaningful and statistically significant fatigue improvements in both dose arms after only 12 weeks underscore the strong therapeutic potential of nasal foralumab in a population with no FDA-approved therapies for na-SPMS BOSTON, MA, November 5, 2026 – Tiziana Life Sciences, Ltd.

(Nasdaq: TLSA) (“Tiziana” or the “Company”), a biotechnology company developing breakthrough immunomodulation therapies with its lead development candidate, intranasal foralumab, a fully human anti-CD3 monoclonal antibody, today announced that it will host a conference call and webcast with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) to discuss the positive topline results from its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab in non-active secondary progressive multiple sclerosis (na-SPMS).
